name: pdftomp3-plugin
description: Prepare documents in your AI chat and listen with PDFTOMP3-Plugin.

interface.longDescription: Use PDFTOMP3-Plugin to read a PDF in Codex, write its spoken text, and send it to your PDF TO MP3 account. Choose a voice or use several speakers for reading, explanations, and summaries. Your saved OpenAI or Gemini key pays for speech. The helper runs on your computer and connects through browser sign-in.
